⚠️ BẠN ĐANG MỞ Ở CHẾ ĐỘ XEM TRƯỚC — ÂM THANH SẼ KHÔNG CHẠY

👉 Hãy mở bài học bằng đường link https:// mà giáo viên gửi (bấm vào link trong Zalo ➔ chọn biểu tượng la bàn Safari).
Bấm để máy tự động đọc lần lượt từng từ và hiển thị theo dõi (phù hợp học trên điện thoại)
1. accommodation (n)
/əˌkɒməˈdeɪʃn/
chỗ ở, nơi cư trú (danh từ không đếm được)
Collocation: student accommodation, rented accommodation
"Finding affordable student accommodation near the city centre is quite difficult."
2. residential (adj)
/ˌrezɪˈdenʃl/
thuộc khu dân cư, dành cho nhà ở
Collocation: residential area, quiet residential neighbourhood
"The northern part of the island has been developed into a quiet residential area."
3. construct (v)
/kənˈstrʌkt/
xây dựng, kiến thiết (tòa nhà, cầu đường)
Collocation: construct a new bridge, newly constructed
"The local council plans to construct a modern sports complex next to the park."
4. demolish (v)
/dɪˈmɒlɪʃ/
phá dỡ, san phẳng (tòa nhà cũ trong bài Map)
Collocation: demolish the old factory, completely demolished
"The abandoned warehouse was demolished to make way for a new shopping mall."
5. renovate (v)
/ˈrenəveɪt/
cải tạo, trùng tu, nâng cấp cho mới
Collocation: renovate an old building, newly renovated
"The historic town library has been renovated and equipped with digital computers."
6. expand (v)
/ɪkˈspænd/
mở rộng diện tích, nới rộng quy mô
Collocation: expand the car park, rapidly expanding city
"Since 2015, the university has expanded its main campus to the east."
7. convert (v)
/kənˈvɜːt/
chuyển đổi công năng (từ A thành B: convert into)
Collocation: convert into a museum, convert farmland into
"The old cinema on Main Street was converted into a modern art gallery."
8. spacious (adj)
/ˈspeɪʃəs/
rộng rãi, thoáng đãng
Collocation: spacious apartment, spacious living room
"Houses in the suburbs are much more spacious than tiny city-centre flats."
9. affordable (adj)
/əˈfɔːdəbl/
có giá cả phải chăng, vừa túi tiền
Collocation: affordable housing, at an affordable price
"Governments should build more affordable housing for young working families."
10. suburb (n)
/ˈsʌbɜːb/
vùng ngoại ô, khu ven đô
Collocation: leafy suburb, live in the suburbs
"Many families move to the suburbs to enjoy cleaner air and larger gardens."
11. skyscraper (n)
/ˈskaɪskreɪpə(r)/
tòa nhà chọc trời, cao ốc hiện đại
Collocation: glass skyscraper, towering skyscraper
"Several glass skyscrapers have been built in the financial district since 2010."
12. facility (n)
/fəˈsɪləti/
cơ sở vật chất, tiện ích công cộng
Collocation: recreational facilities, medical facilities
"The new residential estate offers excellent recreational facilities, including a pool."
13. pedestrian (n)
/pəˈdestriən/
người đi bộ; (adj) dành riêng cho người đi bộ
Collocation: pedestrian zone, pedestrian walkway
"The busy market road has been turned into a safe pedestrian zone with no cars."
14. adjacent (adj)
/əˈdʒeɪsnt/
nằm sát cạnh, liền kề (đi với giới từ 'to')
Collocation: adjacent to the station, adjacent building
"A new café has been opened directly adjacent to the central railway station."
15. modernize (v)
/ˈmɒdənaɪz/
hiện đại hóa, tân trang theo chuẩn mới
Collocation: modernize the port, modernize public infrastructure
"Over the last decade, the city has modernized its harbour and ferry terminal."

⚙️ 2. Bài Giảng Ngữ Pháp 2 Tầng (Grammar Masterclass)

🟢 Tầng 1: Căn Bản (Thì Hiện Tại Hoàn Thành Trong Mô Tả Sự Thay Đổi Đô Thị)

• Công thức Chủ động: S + have / has + V3/ed (Diễn tả sự thay đổi bắt đầu trong quá khứ và kéo dài đến hiện tại).
  - Dấu hiệu nhận biết trong IELTS Task 1 Map: since 2010, over the last twenty years, in recent decades, recently.
  Ví dụ: Since 2005, the town has modernized its transport facilities.

• Công thức Bị động (Cực kỳ quan trọng cho Writing Task 1 Map): S + have / has + been + V3/ed
  - Ví dụ 1: The old factories have been demolished.
  - Ví dụ 2: The farmland in the north has been converted into a residential area.

🔵 Tầng 2: Nâng Cao (Hệ Thống Giới Từ Định Vị Bản Đồ - Map Prepositions)

• Chỉ hướng la bàn: in the north / south / east / west / north-east of the town (nằm ở phía Bắc/Nam... bên trong thị trấn) vs. to the north of (nằm ở phía Bắc bên ngoài đối tượng).
  Ví dụ: A new supermarket has been constructed in the north-west of the town, adjacent to the residential zone.

• Cấu trúc thay thế vị trí chuẩn Band 7.5+:
  - ... was demolished to make way for ... (bị phá dỡ để nhường chỗ cho...)
  - ... was replaced by ... (được thay thế bởi...)

🎯 20 Câu Test Từ Vựng (Vocabulary Mastery Test)

1. The old shoe factory on the riverfront was ________ to make way for a public park.
2. First-year university students usually live in shared campus ________.
3. The historic post office was not knocked down; instead, it was ________ into a community museum.
4. A quiet ________ area with 200 family houses has been built in the northeast of the town.
5. The city council decided to ________ the central library rather than build a completely new one.
6. Because traffic was too heavy, the main shopping street was turned into a car-free ________ zone.
7. The new sports centre is located directly ________ to the high school entrance.
8. Many young couples cannot buy flats in the city centre and need more ________ housing.
9. Over the last ten years, the airport has ________ its terminal to handle twice as many passengers.
10. Our new flat in the ________ has three spacious bedrooms and a lovely back garden.
11. Engineers are planning to ________ a high-speed railway bridge across the harbour.
12. The financial district is famous for its glass ________ that have over fifty floors.
13. Although the apartment is slightly far from work, the living room is bright and ________.
14. The town has invested millions of pounds to ________ its old hospital and sports ________.
15. In the south of the map, the green farmland has been replaced by a modern ________ estate.
16. [Ôn tập Unit 6] Growing up with three ________ taught him how to share and cooperate.
17. [Ôn tập Unit 6] Mutual respect helps different generations live together in ________.
18. [Ôn tập Unit 5] New smart-home software can improve energy ________ in modern apartments.
19. [Ôn tập Unit 3] Planting trees along city streets helps reduce air pollution and carbon ________.
20. [Ôn tập Unit 2] University students must submit their final architecture ________ before Friday.
Điểm: 0/20

⚙️ 10 Câu Test Ngữ Pháp Ứng Dụng (Grammar Mastery Test)

1. Since 2010, three new residential towers ________ in the northwest of the city.
2. Over the past twenty years, the small fishing village ________ into a busy tourist resort.
3. The old market in the town centre was demolished ________ make way for a pedestrian plaza.
4. A new bus station has been built directly adjacent ________ the central shopping mall.
5. The wooden bridge in the south of the map ________ by a modern concrete bridge.
6. Recently, the local authorities ________ the historic theatre and added a riverside café.
7. The industrial warehouse on the east bank has been converted ________ an indoor sports facility.
8. Note that 'accommodation' is an uncountable noun, so we say: Student accommodation ________ expensive here.
9. A large car park has been constructed ________ the north-east of the hospital.
10. My family ________ in this quiet suburb for fifteen years, and we love its green parks.
Điểm: 0/10

Tốc độ đọc:
Trạng thái: Sẵn sàng phát Câu: 0 / 15
💡 Bấm vào bất kỳ câu thoại nào để nghe riêng câu đó:
👨 Housing Officer: Good morning, University Accommodation Office! How can I assist you with your housing application?
👩 Student: Hello! I am a new postgraduate student, and I am looking for affordable accommodation near the campus.
👨 Housing Officer: Welcome! Have you seen the updated campus map? Our housing facilities have changed a lot since last year.
👩 Student: Oh, really? I heard that the old North Hall was demolished.
👨 Housing Officer: Actually, North Hall was not demolished. It has been completely renovated into spacious studio flats. 💡 Bẫy phủ định & thông tin đúng câu 1: renovated
👩 Student: That sounds great! Where is North Hall located on the campus map?
👨 Housing Officer: It is in the northwest corner, directly adjacent to the Botanical Garden. 💡 Đáp án câu 2: Botanical Garden
👩 Student: Are vehicles allowed on the road in front of the dormitory?
👨 Housing Officer: No, that road has been converted into a quiet pedestrian walkway for students and cyclists. 💡 Đáp án câu 3: pedestrian walkway / pedestrian
👩 Student: What about sports or recreational facilities nearby?
👨 Housing Officer: The university has just constructed a new indoor swimming pool to the east of the library. 💡 Đáp án câu 4: swimming pool
👩 Student: How much is the monthly rent for a renovated studio flat in North Hall?
👨 Housing Officer: It used to be 480 pounds, but with utilities included, the current rent is 520 pounds per month. 💡 Bẫy giá cũ vs giá hiện tại câu 5: 520
👩 Student: Who should I contact to book a viewing this afternoon?
👨 Housing Officer: Please ask for the resident manager, Mr. Crawford. That is spelled C - R - A - W - F - O - R - D. 💡 Đáp án đánh vần câu 6: CRAWFORD
Điểm: 0/6

📰 IELTS Academic Reading: Passage & Questions

[Paragraph A - Industrial Past to Modern Residential Hub]
Over the last twenty years, Riverside Town has undergone a dramatic urban transformation. In 2005, the southern riverbank was dominated by old brick warehouses and a noisy coal port. Since then, the town council has worked hard to modernize the entire waterfront. The abandoned factories have been demolished to make way for spacious parks and affordable apartment blocks, turning the area into a popular residential neighbourhood.

[Paragraph B - New Commercial & Recreational Facilities]
In the town centre, several historic buildings were not destroyed; instead, the old corn exchange has been carefully renovated and converted into an indoor food market. Directly adjacent to the market, developers have constructed two glass office skyscrapers. Furthermore, to reduce traffic noise, High Street has been transformed into a tree-lined pedestrian zone where residents can enjoy outdoor cafés and modern recreational facilities.

[Paragraph C - Expanding into the Green Suburbs]
As the population has grown, the town has also expanded eastward into the surrounding suburbs. New university accommodation has been built near the eastern woods, connected to the centre by an electric tram line. Overall, Riverside Town has successfully balanced economic growth with comfortable urban living.
Điểm: 0/6

✍️ Academic Writing Lab (Chuyên đề IELTS Task 1: MAP COMPARISON)

Đề bài: Write a short report (70 - 90 words) describing the main changes in Riverside Town between 2005 and the present day (factories demolished for residential flats, old market converted into an art gallery, High Street turned into a pedestrian zone, and sports facilities expanded).

Tiêu chuẩn: Sử dụng thì Hiện tại hoàn thành bị động (have/has been + V3/ed), cụm giới từ chỉ vị trí (in the south / adjacent to), và ít nhất 4 từ vựng Map của Unit 7 (demolish, construct, convert, renovate, expand, residential, pedestrian, facility, modernize...).
